checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both closed hands stay on machine handles.
checks.feet: Both feet clear the floor; arms extended at 179 degrees and hands stay on the overhead bar. Shoulders depressed relative to the dead-hang reference; torso rises without bending the elbows. Static hold without swinging.
checks.movement: Static active overhead hang with shoulder girdle depressed by 12-degree clavicle rotations, arms at 179 degrees and fixed grip. Body rises relative to passive reference without elbow flexion. Eight-second maintained hold; entry and exit omitted.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
